messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=api-inference-us-east (PD: P1). Trigger=5xx spike on /v1/generate. Pager: pagerduty-incidents@redwood.com. Auto-escalation in 90s if not acked.

pagerbot: Details: recent_5xx_rate=18% (3m), p50_latency=220ms, p95_latency=1.2s. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/stream. Suspected upstream: batch router overload. Runbook: <https://go/redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx|inference-5xx runbook>.

lia: seeing this in prod dashboard too, +1. confirming spike across both replicas.

tom: on it, acking on PD. grabbing logs from the router.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: Incident 2026-03-14T17:46:29Z - acknowledged by tom.

tom: quick update — initial check: redis prefix cache healthy, KV cache hit rate normal. Router pods show high goroutine count and repeated 502 from model-proxy-2. tail of router logs:``` 
E0321 17:44:02 router.go:412] upstream error: dial tcp 10.2.5.18:8080: connect: connection refused
E0321 17:44:03 router.go:412] upstream error: dial tcp 10.2.5.18:8080: connection refused
```

vera: model-proxy-2 is on the same node as a heavy job (dedicated-spot job). Could be noisy neighbor. I can cordon and drain that node if we want to kill the job.

tom: nice catch. before cordon — can we try soft-fallback to model-proxy-3 (hot spare) to reduce 502s? Is there a routing override we can flip?

lia: yes, we have a flag in the router config: `prefer_hot_spares=true` but it only triggers on health-check pass. model-proxy-3 passes health but weight is 0 for this model group due to last rollout. we can bump weight to 1 via api: `POST /admin/routing/weights {"model_group":"gpt-4r","target":1}`

eng-oncall: I can run that API. running now...

eng-oncall: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood.internal/admin/routing/weights -d '{"model_group":"gpt-4r","target":1}'` -> 200 OK.

tom: bump applied. watching logs and metrics.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Router config change recorded (audit id: audit_8a7f).

lia: metrics: 502 rate dropping, 5xx from 18% -> 6% in the last 60s. latency p95 improving too.

tom: still seeing a few `connection refused` from model-proxy-2. planning to cordon the node in 2m if no further improvement. Any objections?

vera: go ahead. I'll start a graceful drain and move the heavy job to standby. note: live-migration will add a bit of load but safer than letting proxy flail.

tom: executing:``` 
# cordon node
kubectl cordon ip-10-2-5-18.ec2.internal
kubectl drain ip-10-2-5-18.ec2.internal --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

lia: watching pods reschedule. model-proxy-2 had 3 active connections, draining now.

pagerbot: :information_source: Update: PagerDuty incident active. Current owner: tom. Next escalation in 30m if not resolved.

tom: pods rescheduled, health checks for model-proxy group are green across the cluster. 5xx rate now 0.8%.

vera: I've also put an ops note to rollback the weight change after we confirm stability. we'll want to make the weight change part of a formal canary next week.

tom: agreed. I'll keep the PD incident open for 30 more minutes for monitoring, then mark resolved if stable. Any customer impact to record?

lia: one customer-support ticket came in reporting timeouts for a paywalled integration around 17:43 UTC, likely related. CS ticket ID: CS-8473. Recommend including that in the incident notes and reaching out if SLA affected.

eng-oncall: adding timeline to incident doc:``` 
- 17:44:02 - spike detected, 5xx 18%
- 17:44:29 - pagerbot page fired
- 17:45:10 - tom acked
- 17:46:00 - route weight bumped to hot spare
- 17:47:30 - node cordoned + drained
- 17:49:10 - 5xx back to <1%
```

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: Incident update saved to PD (Incident 2026-03-14T17:46:29Z).

tom: closing loop — I will follow up with a short post-incident note in #postmortems after PD resolved. For now, marking as monitoring. :thumbsup:

vera: thanks team. good coordination. I'll uncordon once we've migrated heavy job and confirm no regression.

lia: ping in 25m for final status.

pagerbot: :bell: Reminder scheduled in 25m for incident check-in.

eng-oncall: leaving logs and diagnostic bundle at https://artifacts.redwood/internal/incident/2026-03-14-2923456789 .

tom: final check — all green, PD status set to resolved. documenting CS ticket and next steps.```
